title: Choose your starting path
lesson: Your starting circumstances affect the financial choices available to you.

title: A birthday boost
body: Happy 18th birthday! Your family gives you $1,000. What do you want to do with it?
lesson: The account you invest through matters, not just what you invest in.

choices.title: Start Investing
choices.description: Open an account; choose an investment next month

choices.title: Put it in Savings
choices.description: Move the $1,000 gift to your emergency fund

title: Your first investment
body: Give your money a job. Where should it go?
lesson: Investments fluctuate. A short-term loss does not automatically mean an investment was a bad decision.

choices.title: Buy a diversified ETF
choices.description: Recommended demo path · spread your exposure

choices.title: Buy individual stocks
choices.description: One fictional company · more concentrated risk

title: An extra $500
body: You have an extra $500 this month. What do you want to do?
lesson: Good financial planning balances investing, savings, and debt.

choices.title: Pay down debt
choices.description: Pay up to $500 · keep any remainder in cash

title: Life happens
body: Your car needs a $700 repair. Let’s keep you moving.
lesson: Emergency savings can prevent you from selling investments when unexpected expenses happen.

title: A raise. A new habit.
body: You got a raise! You now have an extra $100 every month. Give it a plan, starting next month.
lesson: Consistent investing can matter more than trying to perfectly time the market.

choices.title: Pay $100/month toward debt
choices.description: After debt is cleared, keep the rest in cash

choices.title: Split the money
choices.description: $50 to an ETF · $50 to your emergency fund
